name: Building directory
description: A lobby directory for an office building, mall or campus: every tenant with its floor and suite, grouped by floor or listed A to Z with an index, direction arrows, a "You are here" line and a clock. Lays itself out in columns to fill the screen and pages through long lists. Type the tenants in, or keep them in a Google Sheet or Manual table.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: address
params.label: Address or subtitle
params.help: One line under the building name. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: Optional. Without one, the building’s initials are shown in the accent colour.

params.name: here_text
params.label: “You are here” line
params.default: You are here · Main lobby, ground floor
params.help: Shown under the header with a map pin. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: here_floor
params.label: Floor of this screen
params.help: Written the same way as in the Floor column. That floor is marked with a pin in the list and the floor index.

params.name: show_index
params.label: Show the index bar
params.help: A to Z letters (or the floors, or the categories) along the bottom; the ones on the current page light up.

params.name: directory

params.label: Floor names

params.name: floor_word
params.label: Word for “floor”
params.help: Used in headings like “Floor 7”. Leave empty for the word in the screen’s language. A word you type goes in front of the number; put {n} where the number goes (“{n}F”, “Level {n}”).

params.label: Footer line
params.default: Lifts to all floors are straight ahead · Visitors please sign in at reception
params.help: Small print along the bottom. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: empty_text
params.label: Text when the list is empty
params.help: Leave empty for “No tenants listed yet” in the screen’s language.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Clock timezone
params.help: Leave empty to use the screen’s own clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: For the board’s own words, the date, the clock and A to Z sorting. Leave empty for the screen’s language.

params.name: page_seconds
params.label: Seconds per page
params.help: Only used when the list is too long to fit on one screen at a readable size.
